briefing: Markets turned risk-off today with NASDAQ down 1.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.8%, and no new candidates were screened. We're holding all 7 existing positions and keeping cash on the sidelines rather than forcing a buy into a down day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors broadly pull back from riskier assets like stocks, often moving toward cash or safer investments. On days like this, it's usually better to hold your existing positions and avoid chasing new buys, since lower-conviction trades made under pressure tend to perform worse.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」(Risk-Off)日是指投資者普遍減少持有股票等風險較高的資產,轉向現金或更安全的投資。在這類日子,通常較好的做法是持有現有倉位,避免倉促追入新標的,因為在市場壓力下做出的低信心交易往往表現較差。

market_education.summary_en: Broad tech-led selling pushed NASDAQ down 1.5% and the S&P 500 down 0.8% today, with no single catalyst identified in the available data. Risk-off days like this often reflect profit-taking or shifting rate expectations rather than company-specific news. With no screened candidates available and a negative market tone, staying patient is the prudent choice.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日科技股領跌,納斯達克指數下跌1.5%,標普500指數下跌0.8%,暫未有明確單一催化因素。這類避險日通常反映獲利回吐或市場對利率預期的轉變,而非個股基本面變化。由於今日沒有篩選出新的潛在標的,加上市場氣氛偏向保守,按兵不動是較穩健的做法。
